info.title: ZionFood API
info.description: API v1. Token abilities supplement tenant and location authorization. Browser session mutations require CSRF tokens. Money is integer minor units. Romanian is the default human-message language; explicit Accept-Language ro/en is supported without translating schema keys or enum values. Webhook operations require a verified owner/manager browser session.
